title: Contract Pricing Note: Category Share on VendPoint Retired Item Credits
content:
The product category written on a retired item's removal line in the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement adds a category share to the vend error credit Corbett owes, on a VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine, for the failed vend of that retired item.

The category share follows the product category on the retired item's removal line: an item in the safety and PPE category carries the PPE share, an item in the cutting tools or the abrasives category carries the consumable share, and any other item carries none.

| Category on the removal line | Category share |
|---|---|
| Safety and PPE | 0.25 (PPE share) |
| Cutting tools | 0.1 (consumable share) |
| Abrasives | 0.1 (consumable share) |
| Any other category | None |

The removal line read is the one that identifies the retired item: the customer's contract price line written as a removal carrying the highest change reference on the agreement. Hypothetical examples: a removal line in safety and PPE gives 0.25; one in welding gives none.
